title: Cycle bandwidth provisioning & skill-stagger matrix for cross-team coverage
creator: Elena Torres
description: Problem: We frequently hit mid-cycle resource crunches when multiple initiatives surface blockers at the same time. Current ad-hoc coverage (volunteers / manager ping) causes uneven skill coverage and surprises downstream commitments. Goal: Define a reproducible provisioning model that maps available cycle bandwidth to role-level buffers and a deterministic skill-stagger matrix so teams can plan soft-frozen slices with clear shadowing rules. Outcome: a lightweight operational runbook + spreadsheet tool and one pilot with Platform and Console teams this cycle.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A published "Skill-Stagger Matrix" spreadsheet (editable) showing per-role buffer allocation for the cycle; 2) Runbook doc with >3 scenarios (normal, high-turnover, emergency ramp) and decision triggers; 3) Pilot with Platform team that follows the matrix for two weeks and captures telemetry; 4) Dashboard card in Console showing buffer utilization and missed commits per team.
data_sources_and_metrics: Inputs: historical cycle burn (past 6 cycles), team velocity per role (engineer, infra, SRE, PM, Design), on-call incident hours, unplanned bug rate. Metrics: spare_FTE_equivalent, buffer_utilization_pct, missed_commit_count, mean_time_to_recover_plan (days). Primary dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood/internal/capacity/buffer-utilization (read-only monitoring view).
implementation_plan: 1) Triage & scope (this ticket) — define roles and baseline velocity (owners: Marcus & Priya); 2) Data pull & baseline calculation (ENG analytics: deliver CSV by 2026-03-13); 3) Prototype matrix in Google Sheet and iterate with Platform/Console leads; 4) Draft runbook in Confluence and link to cycle templates; 5) Pilot rollout to Platform team for two-week window; 6) Collect telemetry and retrospective, then publish as org-level playbook.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-reserving reduces throughput; Mitigation: cap reserve at 12% by default and expose adjustable slider per initiative. Risk: Inter-team friction when borrowing buffers; Mitigation: formalize 'soft-claim' window (48h) and escalation path to product council. Risk: Data noise (one-off spikes) — Mitigation: use 6-cycle rolling median and manual overrides.
